lines.say: This is the cooling loop, seen from above.
lines.show: This is the cooling loop, seen from above.

lines.say: Every four S U pod carries its own C D U and pump at the wall end.
lines.show: Every 4SU pod carries its own CDU and pump at the wall end.

lines.say: It draws cool liquid from the bottom of the store. A second pipe returns the warmed liquid to the top.
lines.show: Each CDU draws from the cool bottom layer and returns warm liquid to the top.

lines.say: Sixty-four pods put fifty megawatts of heat into the store this way.
lines.show: 64 pods put 50 MW of heat into the store this way.

lines.say: Outside, every dry cooler has a pump of its own.
lines.show: Outside, every dry cooler has a pump of its own.

lines.say: It draws from the warm upper layer and returns cooled liquid to the bottom.
lines.show: The coolers draw from the warm upper layer and return cooled liquid to the bottom.

lines.say: Diffuser plates spread the flow sideways to keep the layers apart.
lines.show: Diffuser plates spread the flow sideways to keep the layers apart.

lines.say: The store between them lets heat collection and heat rejection run independently.
lines.show: The store between them lets heat collection and heat rejection run independently.
